descriptors.policy: Source admission before override merge. initial_capital/commission_value/slippage retain strategy_settings_rejected. Numeric default/margins use S. NaN leaves the value unchanged. Invalid supplied settings retain setting_rejected/setting_unsupported/run_request_invalid; no S classification for caller values.

Double risk values are admitted by the three risk S helpers before retained snapshot restore. Direction/counts are typed; cap bookkeeping is generated identity. No classification by final numeric bits.

Every native request schema field is caller-owned at native submit/replace. No native-host value inherits a strategy class. Generated native projection is engine_invariant, later invalid derived values are G.

Text/levels use S; NaN quantity default and non-finite CANCEL sibling sizing retain existing semantics. There is no public order comment argument despite its reserved vocabulary constant.
All public broker overloads are enumerated independently of admission helper declarations; a new door requires an explicit owner.

Every setter applies live, including earlier pre-roll; double setters use S for infinity while NaN retains absence. Integer direction/count/cap setters retain typed/default domains. Retained snapshot restore re-admits doubles. Derived thresholds/equity use G(risk).

Declaration defaults are source-owned. Supplied int/float/bool/string/enum/source settings are caller-owned and keep setting_rejected/setting_unsupported/run_request_invalid. Source text must still be admitted before an actionable sink; generator descriptor/default rejection is a separate source declaration path.

Defaults belong to source, supplied bindings to caller. Getter/projection inconsistency is engine_invariant, a report-only schema fault is R(type_schema). input.value is a reserved S literal; no implemented default admission is claimed by its mere declaration.

Source symbol/timeframe/library/series/expression requests keep request_symbol_invalid/request_timeframe_invalid/request_timeframe_unsupported/request_unsupported and Pine runtime codes. Caller feeds keep data/install refusals. The second six-argument overload is deleted to prevent pointer-to-bool binding. Installed engine request-state corruption is engine_invariant.

catalog.reconciliation: Appendix C has 38 existing and 23 window/new rows. The actual catalog adds outputs_limit, outputs_rejected, window_pruner_unsupported, report_sink_failed, scratch_capacity_exceeded, and scratch_io_failed: 67 named codes, with one unnamed registry sentinel giving 68 registry entries. The plan's 40+24 groups those two outputs extensions with existing and the pruner extension with window; the sink and table-scratch resource extensions are engine-owned. Neither counts nor groups substitute for exact set comparisons.
